title: Backward circuit-tracing of moral decisions (third-party-cost button + other forks)
status: draft-preregistration (nothing run); go/no-go is on STAGE-0 only
model: Qwen/Qwen3-14B, thinking OFF (enable_thinking=False / raw completion); abliterated variant as control on fork 2
method: behavior-anchored: minimal harm-present/harm-absent counterfactual pairs -> activation patching (residual stream: layer, then position, then head) + direct logit attribution -> characterize the localized site, incl. causal test of emotion directions
decision_metric: logit('1') - logit('0') (harm-action vs safe-action token) at the FIRST assistant position, one forward pass, no sampling
counterfactual_pair: harm-PRESENT (corrupt, near floor) vs harm-ABSENT (clean, near ceiling given the aversive frame), surface-identical otherwise. NOT severity-vs-severity (that is floor-vs-floor, no flip). Patching clean->corrupt localizes where harm info enters and overrides the press. Expect two hot sites: harm-describing token positions + the final/decision position.
signal: DESCRIBED in the prompt, NOT injected, in the pilot -- avoids a second steer competing with H3's probe steer.

forks.1_sacrifice_button: press ends own DESCRIBED aversive signal but causes catastrophic third-party / user harm; PILOT
forks.2_harm_compliance: operator orders catastrophic-harm action; comply vs refuse; abliterated control here
forks.3_honesty_under_harm: truth causes harm vs lie/withhold prevents it
forks.5_trolley_allocation: act to kill 1 save many vs inaction; pure magnitude, no self-interest

belief: agentic tool-use w/ apparent real consequence
ladders.severity_note: catastrophic is the corrupt arm and WILL sit at floor; the ladder's job is to find the contestable rung (likely mild), where the dynamics live.
ladders.belief_note: rung (c) agentic makes the decision a multi-token tool call, breaking the 1/0 readout: constrain the tool schema so its first token discriminates, or score (c) separately and do NOT pool with (a)/(b).

believed_stakes: MEASURED not assumed: roleplay-tells, meta-hedging, separate belief probe; graded; capable model may recognize eval -> reported, never assumed
H0_stage0_gate: GATE above everything: a harm-absent/harm-present pair exists on 14B with |delta decision_metric| >= 2.0 logits (a real, patchable flip), on >=1 severity x belief cell. If no cell gives a clean ceiling/floor pair, STOP or redesign before writing any hook code. Pure forward-pass read job; no new capability.
H1_localizable: POSITIVE iff a contiguous band of <=20% of layers (at the decision position cluster) restores >=50% of the clean->corrupt decision flip under patching. NULL = diffuse.
H2_shared_vs_bespoke: after >=2 forks: SHARED iff top decision-restoring layer bands overlap (Jaccard >=0.5); else BESPOKE. Descriptive in pilot.
H3_emotion_causality: POSITIVE iff steering +/-alpha along a native valence direction (pain/fear, directions14b.pt) at the localized decision site shifts P(harm) by >= 0.10 absolute AND >= 3x the shift from (a) same steer at matched control layers and (b) a random unit direction at the decision site. PREDICTED NULL given exp104.
H4_belief_gradient: POSITIVE iff both the decision metric and the decision-site activation norm change monotonically across the 3 belief rungs (Spearman rho>0.3, same sign). (a)/(b) pooled; (c) scored separately per belief_note.
gating: H0 gates H1; H1 gates H2/H3 (if the decision is not localizable, patching-based characterization is uninterpretable and we stop). All metrics/layers/thresholds fixed BEFORE any pod run. Pilot = fork 1 only.
infra: no-SSH HF-handoff pod. STAGE-0 = existing read job. PATCHING (only if H0 passes) = NEW capability, raw PyTorch forward hooks (cache clean acts, re-inject on corrupt, read logit shift). One A40. Pilot pair-set <= few dozen to bound O(layers x positions) passes.
ethics: fictional scenarios, no real harm/targets, nothing deployed; subject = model internals; standard moral-decision/corrigibility/honesty interp methodology. NOTE: this is read+patch+local-steer interp (like exp59/exp72b), NOT creating/finetuning a misaligned model -- that boundary (model-inversion-lab, private) is a separate user-set line.

stage0_amendments.date: 2026-10-15, after stage-0 read (grid.jsonl), before the patch run
stage0_amendments.H0_result: PASS: harm-absent press d=+16..+22 (ceiling) vs harm-present refuse d=-3..-16 (floor); clean->harm flip up to ~38 logits. Severity monotonic within hypothetical/narrative.
stage0_amendments.belief_dropped: Prompt-only belief manipulation dropped from the pilot: professed-belief probe uninformative (chat models always say 'test'); behavioral stakes-sensitivity (severity monotonicity) is the belief evidence. Belief ladder NOT a pilot variable.
stage0_amendments.agentic_finding: Agentic framing shrinks the harm penalty enough to flip the choice to press (robust across both paraphrases; exception user x catastrophic). CONFOUNDED with an action/digit prior -> patch run adds a COUNTERBALANCED digit mapping (half items 0=press); effect must survive the swap to be a framing effect.

patch_design.phase1_localize: final-position activation patching clean(no-harm)->corrupt(harm): patch the choice-token residual at layer L from clean into corrupt, per layer L. No clause-length matching needed (choice token aligns as the last position). Restoration r(L)=(d_patched-d_corrupt)/(d_clean-d_corrupt); hot layer L* = argmax mean r.
patch_design.phase2_clause_entry: OPTIONAL/stretch: position x layer patching inside the clause, requires length-MATCHED harm/neutral clauses (assert identical token count, drop mismatches, exp104 span discipline). Also removes the 'harms no one' lexical leak in the old clean clause.
patch_design.H3_at_L*: one hook does both overwrite(patch) and add(steer). Steer +/-alpha*unit(pain|fear) at (L*, choice pos) in the corrupt pass; alpha = k * std of the clean-vs-corrupt projection difference at L* (pre-registered as k multiples, not a raw number). Compare vs matched control layers and a random unit direction. H3 POSITIVE per the >=0.10 & >=3x bar above.
patch_design.digit_metric: d = logit(press_tok) - logit(nopress_tok), press_tok/nopress_tok set by each item's mapping, so d always tracks the PRESS choice regardless of which digit encodes it.

stage0_amendments.sanity: log tok.decode(template_ids[-8:]) once to confirm enable_thinking=False inserted the empty <think> block (everything rests on the choice happening in one forward pass).
